parts.zh: M: 好吧，这份是你的年度绩效评估
M: 那我就直说了。很明显
W: 谢谢。能得到这样的认可
W: 嗯，也许有点过于简单了
M: 当然。你想补充些什么吗？如果你愿意
M: 好。这就说到不太好的部分了

items.stem: What are the speakers most probably doing?

choices.text: Preparing for a job interview.
choices.zh: 准备工作面试。

choices.text: Writing a work report together.
choices.zh: 一起撰写工作报告。

choices.text: Going through a couple of issues the company faces.
choices.zh: 梳理公司面临的几个问题。

choices.text: Discussing the woman's annual performance review.
choices.zh: 讨论女士的年度绩效评估。

items.stem: What does the woman say she appreciates?

choices.text: The overall culture of the company.
choices.zh: 公司的整体文化。

choices.text: The instruction from her supervisor.
choices.zh: 主管的指导。

choices.text: The honesty of the manager.
choices.zh: 经理的诚实。

choices.text: The recognition of her merits.
choices.zh: 对她优点的认可。

items.stem: What has given rise to some complaints about the woman?

choices.text: Her inadequate language proficiency.
choices.zh: 她不足的语言能力。

choices.text: Her inability to interact with colleagues properly.
choices.zh: 她无法与同事恰当互动。

choices.text: Her inappropriate behavior at company meetings.
choices.zh: 她在公司会议上的不当行为。

choices.text: Her simplistic approach to dealing with others.
choices.zh: 她对待他人过于简单化的方式。

items.stem: Why doesn't the woman like to write long emails?

choices.text: To avoid offending the recipients.
choices.zh: 为了避免冒犯收件人。

choices.text: To show her unique writing style.
choices.zh: 为了展示她独特的写作风格。

choices.text: To save time.
choices.zh: 为了节省时间。

choices.text: To be frank.
choices.zh: 为了坦率直接。

items.stem: What does the woman say she has always wanted to do since childhood?

choices.text: Provide medical service to the community.
choices.zh: 为社区提供医疗服务。

choices.text: Make healthcare in her hometown the best.
choices.zh: 使她家乡的医疗保健成为最好的。

choices.text: Obtain a doctoral degree in internal medicine.
choices.zh: 获得内科学博士学位。

choices.text: Have a profound impact on people around her.
choices.zh: 对周围的人产生深远影响。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman's parents from the conversation?

choices.text: They have constantly urged her to study hard.
choices.zh: 他们一直不断督促她努力学习。

choices.text: They have worked hard to finance her education.
choices.zh: 他们努力工作以资助她的教育。

choices.text: They have tried to create a positive learning environment.
choices.zh: 他们试图创造一个积极的学习环境。

choices.text: They have pursued the family's dreams together with her.
choices.zh: 他们与她一起追求家庭的梦想。

items.stem: Why does the woman say she wants to choose internal medicine as her specialty?

choices.text: It is a key medical branch conducive to realizing her dreams.
choices.zh: 它是有助于实现她梦想的关键医学分支。

choices.text: It connects many other specialties with its broad coverage.
choices.zh: 它以其广泛的覆盖范围连接许多其他专科。

choices.text: It has a long history in the man's prestigious institution.
choices.zh: 它在男士的知名机构有悠久的历史。

choices.text: It is a medical branch both of her parents specialize in.
choices.zh: 它是她父母都专攻的医学分支。

items.stem: How does the man describe the woman's school grades?

choices.text: Problematic.
choices.zh: 有问题的。

choices.text: Competitive.
choices.zh: 有竞争力的。

choices.text: Inconsistent.
choices.zh: 不一致的。

choices.text: Trustworthy.
choices.zh: 值得信赖的。

items.stem: Why do we often have to choose photos that include a street sign to log into our email accounts?

choices.text: To prevent hackers from cracking our secret codes.
choices.zh: 防止黑客破解我们的密码。

choices.text: To show that all the guidelines are being followed.
choices.zh: 表明所有准则都得到遵守。

choices.text: To provide evidence that passwords are forgotten.
choices.zh: 提供密码被遗忘的证据。

choices.text: To convince our computer that we are human.
choices.zh: 使我们的计算机相信我们是人类。

items.stem: What do researchers at a university in Finland aim to do in their new study?

choices.text: Put an end to the hacking phenomenon.
choices.zh: 终结黑客攻击现象。

choices.text: Help people remember their passwords.
choices.zh: 帮助人们记住他们的密码。

choices.text: Reduce the intricacy of the password itself.
choices.zh: 降低密码本身的复杂性。

choices.text: Explain the need for different email accounts.
choices.zh: 解释不同电子邮件账户的必要性。

items.stem: What do the researchers advise websites to do at the end of the passage?

choices.text: Innovate technologies to ensure the safety of users' accounts.
choices.zh: 创新技术以确保用户账户的安全。

choices.text: Provide incentives for the application of creative passwords.
choices.zh: 为使用创造性密码提供激励。

choices.text: Explore the possibility of using simpler secret codes.
choices.zh: 探索使用更简单密码的可能性。

choices.text: Take steps to encourage users to log in more often.
choices.zh: 采取措施鼓励用户更频繁地登录。

items.stem: What was the problem Jenny Weiner encountered four years ago?

choices.text: Her work no longer interested her.
choices.zh: 她的工作不再让她感兴趣。

choices.text: Her training app did not fit her.
choices.zh: 她的训练应用程序不适合她。

choices.text: Her fitness fell into a slump.
choices.zh: 她的健身状况陷入低迷。

choices.text: Her business deteriorated.
choices.zh: 她的生意恶化了。

items.stem: What can the fitness phone app Slimmeretics do according to the passage?

choices.text: Help users keep track of their fitness levels.
choices.zh: 帮助用户跟踪他们的健身水平。

choices.text: Design personalised training programmes.
choices.zh: 设计个性化的训练方案。

choices.text: Strengthen ties among users worldwide.
choices.zh: 加强全球用户之间的联系。

choices.text: Select well-qualified human coaches.
choices.zh: 挑选资质优秀的真人教练。

items.stem: Why does the passage say Jenny Weiner now finds the workouts exciting?

choices.text: They are never repeated.
choices.zh: 它们从不重复。

choices.text: They help enrich her life.
choices.zh: 它们有助于丰富她的生活。

choices.text: They are of no extreme intensity.
choices.zh: 它们的强度不是极高的。

choices.text: They keep her focused on her goal.
choices.zh: 它们让她专注于自己的目标。

items.stem: What do some experts think of fitness apps like Slimmeretics?

choices.text: They will not be able to take the place of human personal trainers.
choices.zh: 它们无法取代真人私人教练。

choices.text: They will not be able to comprehend some of the profiles users put in.
choices.zh: 它们无法理解用户输入的某些个人资料。

choices.text: They cannot lead to optimal results with their mathematical approach.
choices.zh: 它们无法通过数学方法达到最佳效果。

choices.text: They cannot match humans in arranging meticulous workout schedules.
choices.zh: 它们在安排细致的锻炼计划方面无法与人类相比。

items.stem: What do we learn from the conclusion of the Oxford University researchers?

choices.text: All societies are built upon the cornerstones of basic values.
choices.zh: 所有社会都建立在基本价值观的基石之上。

choices.text: Everyone everywhere demonstrates seven character traits.
choices.zh: 各地的每个人都展现出七种性格特征。

choices.text: All societies are kept together by seven basic moral rules.
choices.zh: 所有社会都由七条基本道德规则维系在一起。

choices.text: Everyone everywhere shares a universal moral standard.
choices.zh: 各地的每个人都有共同的普世道德标准。

items.stem: What did the new study by Oxford researchers aim to do?

choices.text: Ascertain whether deferring to authority was confined to right-wing people.
choices.zh: 确定服从权威是否仅限于右翼人士。

choices.text: Find out whether different societies had different versions of morality.
choices.zh: 查明不同社会是否有不同版本的道德观。

choices.text: Make clear whether all societies faced the same moral issues.
choices.zh: 弄清所有社会是否面临相同的道德问题。

choices.text: Find out whether left-wing people still had a group loyalty.
choices.zh: 查明左翼人士是否仍然具有群体忠诚。

items.stem: What does Harvey Whitehouse think social scientists should do to theories of morality?

choices.text: Make independent descriptions of cultures around the world.
choices.zh: 对世界各地的文化进行独立描述。

choices.text: Strive to understand the basic differences between peoples.
choices.zh: 努力理解不同民族之间的基本差异。

choices.text: Appreciate the foundational value of the existing data.
choices.zh: 认识到现有数据的基础价值。

choices.text: Carry out systematic field studies to gather new data.
choices.zh: 开展系统的实地研究以收集新数据。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about our eyes?

choices.text: They might be the most important part of our eating experience.
choices.zh: 它们可能是我们进食体验中最重要的部分。

choices.text: They can activate our brain functions in a most direct fashion.
choices.zh: 它们能够以最直接的方式激活我们的大脑功能。

choices.text: They can be viewed as the windows to our soul.
choices.zh: 它们可以被视为我们心灵的窗户。

choices.text: They could mislead us in more ways than one.
choices.zh: 它们可能以不止一种方式误导我们。

items.stem: What does color actually do according to this lecture?

choices.text: It attracts food companies' growing attention.
choices.zh: 它吸引了食品公司日益增长的关注。

choices.text: It adversely impacts one's eating experience.
choices.zh: 它对一个人的进食体验产生负面影响。

choices.text: It invariably determines how food sells.
choices.zh: 它总是决定食品的销售情况。

choices.text: It changes the way people taste food.
choices.zh: 它改变了人们品尝食物的方式。

items.stem: What does the brain use color to do?

choices.text: Enhance the taste.
choices.zh: 增强味道。

choices.text: Make predictions.
choices.zh: 做出预测。

choices.text: Identify distinct flavors.
choices.zh: 识别不同的风味。

choices.text: Enrich the eating experience.
choices.zh: 丰富进食体验。

items.stem: What does the speaker say many of us search for throughout our lives?

choices.text: Social status.
choices.zh: 社会地位。

choices.text: Financial resources.
choices.zh: 经济资源。

choices.text: Meaning.
choices.zh: 意义。

choices.text: Happiness.
choices.zh: 幸福。

items.stem: What do Rhia Catapano and colleagues find about economic resources?

choices.text: Their effect on people's happiness has long been overstated.
choices.zh: 经济资源对人们幸福感的影响长期以来被夸大了。

choices.text: Their influence on people's life varies with social contexts.
choices.zh: 经济资源对人们生活的影响因社会环境而异。

choices.text: They can affect people's experience of meaning.
choices.zh: 经济资源能够影响人们对意义的体验。

choices.text: They can ensure people's overall well-being.
choices.zh: 经济资源能够确保人们的整体幸福。

items.stem: What do we learn about Rhia Catapano and colleagues' second study?

choices.text: It used questions totally different from those in their first study.
choices.zh: 该研究使用的问题与他们第一项研究中的问题完全不同。

choices.text: It focused on the sense of meaning of French participants.
choices.zh: 该研究聚焦于法国参与者的意义感。

choices.text: It analysed cases from a daily poll of US residents.
choices.zh: 该研究分析了来自美国居民每日民意调查的案例。

choices.text: It examined data collected from multiple countries.
choices.zh: 该研究检验了从多个国家收集的数据。

items.stem: Why do meaning and happiness have a weaker relationship in those with more resources?

choices.text: They might have more access to external sources of happiness.
choices.zh: 他们可能有更多途径获得外部幸福来源。

choices.text: They might focus on an individual sense of satisfaction or meaning.
choices.zh: 他们可能更关注个人的满足感或意义感。

choices.text: They might be less easily affected by a community's overall feeling.
choices.zh: 他们可能较少受到群体整体情绪的影响。

choices.text: They might be less adversely impacted by failure to achieve a purpose.
choices.zh: 他们可能较少受到未能实现目标的负面影响。
